title: Panda Adventure Scale spec
description: The Scale spec (gADR-0013): the SINGLE authority for element dimensions and the pixel-art/presentation anchors. Every per-element size number lives here — migrated out of the per-domain configs — and scripts/build_config.py composes them back into each consumer's derived Resource (compose_scale_spec), so the runtime keeps reading its own config shape while sizes have one authored home. The pipelines (asset generation/postprocess) read their target dimensions from this same file. Cross-file rules — two-way kind integrity with enemies_config.json, strict Tier size ordering, two-way pickup-item integrity with progression_config.json, and level-segment tile-grid alignment — live in build_config.validate_scale_semantics. project.godot's display block MIRRORS the presentation fields (the engine reads it directly, so it cannot be derived); the data-seam test cross-checks the mirror.

size2.description: A block size (width, height) in world pixels; each strictly positive.

enemy_box.description: One Enemy Kind's dimensions: the body box, plus the bolt box for a ranged kind and the Time Dilation Field radius for a Warp kind. Which optional keys a kind must carry is a cross-file rule (projectile_size iff ranged, time_field_radius iff the kind has the Warp block) enforced by build_config.validate_scale_semantics.

time_field_radius.description: Time Dilation Field radius in world pixels; strictly positive.

ppu.description: Art-pixel to world-pixel ratio. 1.0 = assets are authored at native world resolution (gADR-0013's pixel-art regime); a future chunkier regime would raise it. Strictly positive.

tile_size.description: The terrain tile unit in world pixels — the grid the View skin's tile vocabulary composes on. Every level segment dimension must be a multiple of it (validate_scale_semantics). A whole number of pixels.

design_base.description: The Design base (GAME-CONTEXT): the fixed design-space viewport (width, height) the game is authored and framed against — NOT an output resolution; outputs are covered by the stretch policy. Mirrored into project.godot's display/window/size settings.

stretch_mode.description: Godot stretch mode (display/window/stretch/mode). canvas_items renders 2D at native output resolution (crisp text on phones — the gADR-0013 choice); viewport would render at the design base and upscale the framebuffer.

stretch_aspect.description: Godot stretch aspect (display/window/stretch/aspect). expand keeps the design-base height and widens the view on wider outputs (Android 19.5:9-20:9 sees MORE world, never less).

texture_filter.description: Default canvas texture filter (rendering/textures/canvas_textures/default_texture_filter). nearest keeps the pixel-art grid hard-edged under scaling.

snap_2d_transforms_to_pixel.description: Mirror of rendering/2d/snap/snap_2d_transforms_to_pixel: snap 2D transforms to whole pixels so sub-pixel camera motion does not shimmer nearest-filtered pixel art.

platform_thickness.description: The standard walkable-segment thickness in world pixels — the rampart/parapet slab the Editor defaults new segments to. A tile-grid multiple (validate_scale_semantics); segment GEOMETRY stays authored content in level_config.json.

player_size.description: Player box (width, height) in world pixels — the actor reference height (GDD Scale Spec chapter) and the Player sprite's canvas target.

player_projectile_size.description: The Laser Gun bolt's box (width, height) in world pixels.

gravity_field_radius.description: Gravity Field radius in world pixels; strictly positive.

obstacle_size.description: Obstacle box (width, height) in world pixels.

enemy_boxes.description: Per-Kind enemy dimensions, keyed by the SAME kind names as enemies_config.json's `kinds` (two-way integrity enforced by validate_scale_semantics). Per-Kind exact boxes with Faction body-shape variety; the issue-level 'boxes per Tier' anchor lands as the enforced strict Tier size ordering (every Minion box < every Elite box < the Boss box), not as per-Tier numbers (gADR-0013).

pickup_sizes.description: Pickup box per droppable item name — the closed Phase-1 item vocabulary, mirroring progression_config.json's drop_items (two-way integrity enforced by validate_scale_semantics; the style's COLOR stays in progression_config).

pickup_spacing.description: Horizontal spacing in world pixels between one death's scattered Pickups; strictly positive.

hud_margin.description: Offset (x, y) in design-space pixels of the HUD stat column from the viewport's top-left corner; each non-negative.

hud_font_size.description: HUD label font size in design-space pixels (previously the implicit engine default, made explicit by gADR-0013); a strictly positive whole number.

end_title_font_size.description: End screen verdict-title font size in design-space pixels; a strictly positive whole number.

end_hint_font_size.description: End screen retry-hint font size in design-space pixels; a strictly positive whole number.
